hint_ladder.title: Orient: Gobyerno Context
hint_ladder.text: Sa barangay, kapag kailangan ng bagong gamit, nagpo-procure sila. Ano ibig sabihin? Nagbabayad sila para makuha 'yun.

hint_ladder.title: Rule: Procurement = Formal Buying
hint_ladder.text: Ang core meaning: mag-acquire ng goods/services by paying. Hindi 'yan bigay, swap, o benta — may perang involved.

hint_ladder.title: Apply: Tanggalin ang opposites
hint_ladder.text: Check options: 'Sale' — selling, 'Donation' — walang bayad, 'Exchange' — trade. Alin ang may payment? 'Purchase'.

hint_ladder.title: Nearly Give Away: Sagot Purchase
hint_ladder.text: Halos pareho ng meaning. 'Procurement' is formal buying; 'purchase' is the direct synonym. Kaya B ang sagot.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'sale' sounds like a transaction, pero ito ang pagbebenta, hindi pagbili—kabaligtaran ng procurement.

B.text: Correct. Procurement means acquiring by purchase, gaya ng pagbili ng gobyerno ng supplies gamit ang pondo—it's formal buying.

C.text: You might have chosen C because 'donation' ay pagkuha rin ng bagay, pero walang bayad—procurement requires payment.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'exchange' involves getting something, pero palitan lang 'yan, hindi direct purchase with money.

next_time_rule: When you see 'procurement,' think 'purchase'—formal buying. Payment is key; distinct from sale, donation, or exchange.
deconstruct_text:
Simple lang. Ang 'procurement' galing sa 'procure'—ibig sabihin kumuha o bumili ng kailangan. Sa gobyerno, kapag nag-procure ng bagong equipment, bumibili sila gamit ang budget. Halimbawa, ang barangay nag-procure ng dump truck—binili nila ito. Kaya synonym: purchase.

Ang kalituhan: 'Sale' ay bentahan—kabaligtaran. 'Donation' ay walang bayad. 'Exchange' ay swap, walang pera. Lahat ito walang direktang payment. Sa procurement, essential ang pagbabayad para makuha ang gamit. Kaya dapat payment ang focus.
